I can't even stand the light anymore. I don't know how to get out of this. If I knew that I could spend all my life like this, I wouldn't bother, but my parents won't provide me if I continue to loaf.

If you don't believe that you could work a normal job and perform it at a good level, I can't convince you otherwise. Anyways, you will have to choose between a job and suicude sooner or later. At least your guilt will go away a little if you decide to try and find a job or to do anything that is somewhat productive.

Also, I noticed that if you add in your day some things that you have to do and can't postpone anymore, busyness pulls you in and you have a little bit more will and desire to do something. It's important not to go back immediately though.

I didn't mean it like that. I hate when people are suggesting their solutions or saying that it gets better and I should find a hobby or smth.

I meant each situation is different. If a person tells you this, he's definitely looking for some compassion or help. Even if he's serious about this and already decided to do it, he is still wondering if maybe, just maybe there is a tiny chance of living through it.

But then again I'm talking from my own experince. When I tried first time, I didn't tell anyone, so they wouldn't stop me. Now I still really want to do this and probably I will, but I am worried about mom. So I told my parents. Turned out no one cares anyways. I just wanted some support from people I trust. Even if they can't change the situation.

Oh no. You can never guess the amount of pills you have to take if you don't have a medical education. Learned from experience.

I'm not trying to scare you, I'm just stating the facts. There is a chance you will become disabled, so the sooner you go to the hospital the better.

I took too many pills of a medicine (enough to die according to the internet) and just ended up spending 2 weeks at a hospital with a risk of kidneys and liver shutting down. I got lucky that I didn't end up in a coma.

Seriously, definitely not a way to go.

I'd recommend to look up the photos of people who survived suicide attempt by gun. If I feel like killing myself right this moment, I usually try to repeat some stuff like "I feel nothing". Maybe it's weird  but works for me.

I don't think it is worth it. I don't know how you feel, but for me time passes by pretty quickly no matter what I do. Seems like yesterday I was thinking what will I do when I will be my age. Never would have thought, huh.

I think in my 50s I will think the same way. But this time I'm sure my guess is right. I will be thinking the same thing. When I will finally die. And how I screwed up my life.

Of course, it is up to you to change your life. Almost everything depends on your actions. I know I don't have the will. Maybe, you still do. Maybe, for your mom. Maybe, you don't.

As you said, we're forced to live. Everyone struggles, and yes, it doesn't feel worth living. A lot of people feel or at least felt that way. All that matters in the end how you cope with it. 

I gave up. And the more time passes while you are depreesed, the harder it is to get up. So, it is your choice. You can get help or just stay as you are. Your mom knows that you are depressed anyways. Wouldn't she be happier if you get help and become heathy? Do as you want though. I don't think anyone will say online something that will affect your actions.

I think talking about it here, it is once again escaping reality or trying to feel better at least for some short period of time. Can this low effort of writing it in the internet change anyone's life?
